title: 第9章 上官老祖第10章 暗夜禁地
content_zh:
上官远天的修为是元婴境三层巅峰，白绍阳的修为则只是结丹境八层巅峰，白发黑衣老者的修为可是元婴境六层大成，修为上的巨大悬殊使他们根本无法与这名白发黑衣老者对抗。
见上官远天与白邵阳向他攻击而来，白发老者抓向张皓旸的右手没有停下而是依旧抓向张皓旸，他的左手向上官远天与白邵阳分别攻出一掌，这看似无比简单的一掌却是将攻击而来的上官远天与白绍阳劈飞，二人被击飞撞到东厅的墙壁之上，口吐鲜血，重重的摔倒在地。
即使重伤，二人仍艰难的站起，踉跄上前想要保护张皓旸。
张皓旸满脸焦急上前搀扶起二人说道：“外公、白爷爷不要再为我造成无谓伤亡！
你们要保重！”
说完，张皓旸就跪下对两人及上官家一众族人跪谢磕头。
“小畜生还不束手就擒”
白发黑衣老者道。
只见张皓旸缓缓站起向白发黑衣老者走去，张皓旸右手拿着一把玄铁匕首藏在袖口之中。
他想对白发黑衣老者实施偷袭，反正横竖都是死不如再拼一下。
白发黑衣老者乃是元婴境六层大成修为，炼体境七层巅峰修为的张皓旸对他来说无疑是蝼蚁一般的存在。
看着向他走来的张皓旸，白发黑衣老者一脸戏谑之色，当看到张皓旸满脸的悲伤表情及无助的眼神时就放松了警惕。
就在张皓旸走到老者近前不到五尺时，他伸出右手对白发老者说：“我过来了，你们抓我吧！”
看到束手就擒的张皓旸，白发黑衣老者哈哈大笑，他擒拿张皓旸的目标眼看就要达成，将张皓旸抓住交给主上，自然会受到主上的奖赏。
想到这些，白发黑衣老者心里不免高兴，伸手就去抓张皓旸的胳膊。
说时迟那时快，张皓旸突然反手，一把泛着寒光的匕首出现，直扎向白发黑衣老者的心脏。
老者过于自信根本没有想到张皓旸会拿匕首刺杀他。
白发黑衣老者身体迅速后撤，但是由于距离太近，躲闪已经来不及了，他只好在躲闪的同时运功抵抗张皓旸的一击。
因速度太快，电光石火间匕首已扎在老者心脏位置，饶是匕首锋利无比但是却无法穿透老者护体神功的防护，对老者造成伤害。
如果张皓旸修为同样是元婴六层，这一击恐怕已经将老者击杀。

但是奈何张皓旸的修为只是炼体境七层巅峰而已，修为的巨大悬殊让张皓旸根本无法手刃仇人。
白发黑衣老者虽没有受伤，但是张皓旸的匕首刺中他的身体，这一举动让他的颜面尽失，于是就听到他有些恼羞成怒的大叫道：“小畜生想杀我，简直是找死！”
只见白发黑衣老者右手一挥，张皓旸的身体就犹如离弦之箭般飞出，紧接着就听到“嘭”
content_en:
Shangguan Yuantian's cultivation is at the peak of the third level of the Nascent Soul Realm, Bai Shaoyang's cultivation is only at the peak of the eighth level of the Core Formation Realm, and the white-haired and black-clothed old man's cultivation is at the sixth level of the Nascent Soul Realm. The huge disparity in cultivation makes it impossible for them to fight against this white-haired, black-clothed old man.
Seeing Shangguan Yuantian and Bai Shaoyang attacking him, the white-haired old man did not stop grabbing Zhang Haoyang's right hand but continued to grab Zhang Haoyang. His left hand struck Shangguan Yuantian and Bai Shaoyang with a palm respectively. This seemingly simple palm flew the attacking Shangguan Yuantian and Bai Shaoyang away. The two were knocked back and hit the wall of the east hall. They vomited blood and fell heavily to the ground.
Even though they were seriously injured, the two of them still stood up with difficulty and stumbled forward to protect Zhang Haoyang.
Zhang Haoyang stepped forward with an anxious look on his face, helped the two of them up, and said, "Grandpa, Grandpa Bai, don't cause any more unnecessary casualties to me!
Take care! "
After saying that, Zhang Haoyang knelt down and knelt down to the two of them and all the Shangguan family members.
"The little beast can't be caught without restraint"
The old man with white hair and black clothes said.
Zhang Haoyang slowly stood up and walked towards the old man with white hair and black clothes. Zhang Haoyang held a black iron dagger in his right hand and hid it in his cuff.
He wanted to launch a sneak attack on the white-haired and black-clothed old man. Anyway, he would die anyway, so it would be better to try again.
The white-haired and black-clothed old man was at the sixth level of the Nascent Soul Realm, and Zhang Haoyang, who was at the peak of the seventh level of the Body Refining Realm, was undoubtedly an ant-like existence to him.
Looking at Zhang Haoyang walking towards him, the old man with white hair and black clothes had a joking look on his face. When he saw the sad expression on Zhang Haoyang's face and the helpless eyes, he relaxed his guard.
Just when Zhang Haoyang walked less than five feet in front of the old man, he stretched out his right hand and said to the white-haired old man: "I'm here, you can catch me!"
Seeing the helpless Zhang Haoyang, the old man with white hair and black clothes burst out laughing. His goal of capturing Zhang Haoyang was about to be achieved. If he caught Zhang Haoyang and handed it over to his master, he would naturally be rewarded by his master.
Thinking of this, the old man with white hair and black clothes couldn't help but feel happy, and reached out to grab Zhang Haoyang's arm.
Soon enough, Zhang Haoyang suddenly backhanded him, and a dagger with a cold light appeared, piercing directly into the heart of the white-haired and black-clothed old man.
The old man was so confident that he never thought that Zhang Haoyang would stab him with a dagger.
The old man with white hair and black clothes retreated quickly, but because the distance was too close, it was too late to dodge. He had to dodge while using his strength to resist Zhang Haoyang's blow.
Because the speed was too fast, the dagger between the lightning and stone fire had been pierced into the heart of the old man. Even though the dagger was extremely sharp, it could not penetrate the protection of the old man's body protection magic and cause harm to the old man.
If Zhang Haoyang's cultivation level was also at the sixth level of Nascent Soul, this blow might have killed the old man.
However, Zhang Haoyang's cultivation level is only at the peak of the seventh level of the Body Refining Realm. The huge disparity in cultivation level makes it impossible for Zhang Haoyang to kill his enemies with his own hands.
Although the old man with white hair and black clothes was not injured, Zhang Haoyang's dagger stabbed his body. This move made him lose all face, so he heard him yelling in anger: "You little beast wants to kill me, you are just looking for death!"
The old man with white hair and black clothes waved his right hand, and Zhang Haoyang's body flew out like an arrow from a string, and then he heard "bang"
